title: Login button unresponsive
description: The login button does nothing after entering valid credentials.

title: Payment fails on checkout
description: Card payments return an error on the final step.

title: Typo on the About page
description: The About page has a spelling mistake in the second paragraph.

title: Cart total is wrong
description: Cart total does not update after removing an item.

title: Slow bug list loading
description: The bug list takes several seconds to load.

title: Filter ignores labels
description: Filtering by label returns all bugs.

title: Profile page shows wrong stats
description: Average severity is miscalculated for users with one bug.

title: Logout leaves menu visible
description: After logout the Manage Users link stays visible until refresh.

title: Image upload hangs
description: Uploading a large image freezes the form with no error.

title: Dark text on dark background
description: Footer text is unreadable in some themes.

title: Search is case sensitive
description: Searching for "login" does not find "Login".

title: Server crashes on empty form
description: Submitting an empty form returns a 500 error.

title: Email validation too strict
description: Valid addresses with a plus sign are rejected.

title: Pagination skips a page
description: Clicking Next twice jumps from page 1 to page 3.

title: Tooltip overlaps button
description: On small screens the tooltip covers the Save button.

title: Session expires too early
description: Users are logged out after a few minutes of inactivity.

title: Duplicate bug entries
description: Creating a bug twice quickly adds two identical rows.

title: Wrong date format
description: Created date shows the US format instead of the local one.

title: Export button missing
description: The export to CSV button is missing for admins.

title: Memory leak in list
description: Scrolling the bug list for a long time slows the browser.
